Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya has built a culture centered around innovation, accountability, and results. We are a high-growth, high-performance organization that values individuals who are driven, adaptable, and committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers and teammates alike.

At Kaseya, success comes from embracing challenges, moving with urgency, and continuously raising the bar.

Position Summary

Kaseya is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-platform technical programs that span multiple SaaS products, engineering organizations, and business functions. In this role, you will operate as a force multiplier for engineering and product leadership, driving execution rigor, dependency management, and delivery predictability across complex initiatives such as platform integrations, modernization efforts, reliability improvements, and enterprise-scale launches. This role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, executive communication, and the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Delivery

- Own and drive end-to-end execution of large, cross-functional technical programs impacting multiple Kaseya products and platforms
- Translate company-level priorities into clear program plans, milestones, success metrics, and delivery commitments
- Actively manage scope, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, and operations teams
- Ensure programs are delivered with high quality, security, and reliability standards appropriate for MSP and enterprise customers

Technical & Architectural Partnership

- Partner closely with engineering leaders and architects to understand system design, platform constraints, and technical risks
- Drive alignment on architecture decisions, sequencing, and integration strategies, especially across acquired products
- Develop technical fluency across Kaseya's SaaS platforms, APIs, data flows, and cloud infrastructure

Stakeholder & Executive Communication

- Serve as the single-threaded owner for program health, communicating clearly with senior engineering, product, and executive leaders
- Produce crisp executive-level updates that highlight progress, risks, mitigation plans, and decision points
- Facilitate decision-making across organizations with competing priorities and limited resources

Operational Excellence & Scale

- Establish scalable program management frameworks, operating rhythms, and tooling to support Kaseya's growth
- Identify systemic execution gaps and drive improvements in planning, dependency management, and delivery predictability
- Mentor and influence other TPMs, helping raise the bar for technical program management across the organization

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Engineering Program Management, or equivalent roles in SaaS or cloud-based software environments
- Strong technical foundation with the ability to engage deeply in architecture, APIs, data, and cloud-native systems
- Proven experience leading multi-team, multi-product programs with significant technical and organizational complexity
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership
- Demonstrated ability to influence without authority in a fast-paced, matrixed organization

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working on platform integration, M&A integration, or large-scale SaaS modernization initiatives
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), distributed systems, and enterprise-grade security requirements
- Experience supporting B2B, IT management, security, or MSP-focused products
- Strong working knowledge of Agile and hybrid delivery models
- Prior experience mentoring TPMs or acting as a program leader across multiple initiatives

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw_extractions.source_text:
About Us

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About This Position

As a Principal Product Manager for Agentic AI Platform at G-P, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our Agentic AI strategy and driving the success of platform capabilities that enable AI-powered experiences across our products and operations. You will work at the intersection of AI, platform services, developer experience, security, data, and enterprise SaaS.

You will be expected to define how agents, tools, APIs, workflows, evaluation frameworks, permissions, and governance models come together to create reliable, secure, and scalable AI capabilities. This is a platform product role with a strong AI focus. The ideal candidate has deep platform product management experience, strong curiosity about AI, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical product outcomes.

What You Will Do

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of Agentic AI platform capabilities, from strategy and discovery to roadmap, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
- Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.
- Drive KPIs that reflect real-world AI and platform impact, including adoption, task completion, answer quality, automation success, deflection, operational efficiency, satisfaction, and reliability.

Minimum Requirements

What we are looking for:

- Experience: 15+ years of product management experience, including owning and driving large-scale technology platforms, AI products, developer-facing products, or enterprise SaaS capabilities across multiple lifecycle stages.
- Agentic AI Product Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI, LLMs, agents, tools, workflows, automation, and orchestration can be applied to enterprise SaaS products. Ability to think beyond chatbot experiences and define how AI can help users complete meaningful tasks and business outcomes.
- AI Quality and Governance: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, test suites, trace analysis, human review, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong awareness of AI risks around accuracy, privacy, security, explainability, permissions, and compliance.
- Technical Depth: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, SaaS business models, microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architectures, API-first design, data integrations, and modern enterprise architecture. Ability to translate technical possibilities into product outcomes.
- Platform Product Management: Strong platform mindset with experience creating reusable capabilities, standards, interfaces, and services that support multiple product teams and business use cases.
- Developer Experience: Ability to build platform services with empathy for developers, including onboarding, authentication, documentation, observability, service discoverability, and lifecycle needs. Prior experience with Internal Developer Portals such as Backstage is a plus.
- Identity, Security, and Access Control: Experience with authentication, authorization, role-based access, policy-based access, API security, OpenAPI, or platform security workflows is highly desirable.
- Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.
- Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.
- Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.
- Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
- Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.
- Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.
- Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.
- Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
- Educational Background: Solid technical foundation, preferably with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees such as M.S. or MBA are a plus.

Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.

Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

- Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
- Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.

Benefits

G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more.

Individuals residing, or applying to work, in the United States: California or Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, please review the following additional information:

G-P will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance. Los Angeles applicants can review additional information regarding the Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act here: Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and Philadelphia applicants can review information pertaining to Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance here: Fair Chance Poster. Any consideration of a candidate’s background check with arrest or conviction records will include an individualized assessment based on the factors required by applicable law, including the candidate’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job.

G-P. Global Made Possible.

G-P is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to building and maintaining a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity. We prohibit discrimination and harassment against employees or applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

G-P also is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these positions. If you need an accommodation due to a disability during the interview process, please contact us at careers@g-p.com.

- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.

About This Position

You will work at the intersection of AI, platform services, developer experience, security, data, and enterprise SaaS.

You will be expected to define how agents, tools, APIs, workflows, evaluation frameworks, permissions, and governance models come together to create reliable, secure, and scalable AI capabilities. This is a platform product role with a strong AI focus. The ideal candidate has deep platform product management experience, strong curiosity about AI, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical product outcomes.

What You Will Do

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of Agentic AI platform capabilities, from strategy and discovery to roadmap, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
- Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.
- Drive KPIs that reflect real-world AI and platform impact, including adoption, task completion, answer quality, automation success, deflection, operational efficiency, satisfaction, and reliability.

Minimum Requirements

- Experience: 15+ years of product management experience, including owning and driving large-scale technology platforms, AI products, developer-facing products, or enterprise SaaS capabilities across multiple lifecycle stages.
- Agentic AI Product Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI, LLMs, agents, tools, workflows, automation, and orchestration can be applied to enterprise SaaS products. Ability to think beyond chatbot experiences and define how AI can help users complete meaningful tasks and business outcomes.
- AI Quality and Governance: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, test suites, trace analysis, human review, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong awareness of AI risks around accuracy, privacy, security, explainability, permissions, and compliance.
- Technical Depth: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, SaaS business models, microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architectures, API-first design, data integrations, and modern enterprise architecture. Ability to translate technical possibilities into product outcomes.
- Platform Product Management: Strong platform mindset with experience creating reusable capabilities, standards, interfaces, and services that support multiple product teams and business use cases.
- Developer Experience: Ability to build platform services with empathy for developers, including onboarding, authentication, documentation, observability, service discoverability, and lifecycle needs. Prior experience with Internal Developer Portals such as Backstage is a plus.
- Identity, Security, and Access Control: Experience with authentication, authorization, role-based access, policy-based access, API security, OpenAPI, or platform security workflows is highly desirable.
- Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.
- Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.
- Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.
- Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
- Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.
- Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.
- Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.
- Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
- Educational Background: Solid technical foundation, preferably with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees such as M.S. or MBA are a plus.

- Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.

About This Position

As a Principal Product Manager for Agentic AI Platform at G-P, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our Agentic AI strategy and driving the success of platform capabilities that enable AI-powered experiences across our products and operations. You will work at the intersection of AI, platform services, developer experience, security, data, and enterprise SaaS.

You will be expected to define how agents, tools, APIs, workflows, evaluation frameworks, permissions, and governance models come together to create reliable, secure, and scalable AI capabilities. This is a platform product role with a strong AI focus. The ideal candidate has deep platform product management experience, strong curiosity about AI, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical product outcomes.

What You Will Do

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of Agentic AI platform capabilities, from strategy and discovery to roadmap, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
- Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.
- Drive KPIs that reflect real-world AI and platform impact, including adoption, task completion, answer quality, automation success, deflection, operational efficiency, satisfaction, and reliability.

- Experience: 15+ years of product management experience, including owning and driving large-scale technology platforms, AI products, developer-facing products, or enterprise SaaS capabilities across multiple lifecycle stages.
- Agentic AI Product Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI, LLMs, agents, tools, workflows, automation, and orchestration can be applied to enterprise SaaS products. Ability to think beyond chatbot experiences and define how AI can help users complete meaningful tasks and business outcomes.
- AI Quality and Governance: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, test suites, trace analysis, human review, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong awareness of AI risks around accuracy, privacy, security, explainability, permissions, and compliance.
- Technical Depth: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, SaaS business models, microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architectures, API-first design, data integrations, and modern enterprise architecture. Ability to translate technical possibilities into product outcomes.
- Platform Product Management: Strong platform mindset with experience creating reusable capabilities, standards, interfaces, and services that support multiple product teams and business use cases.
- Developer Experience: Ability to build platform services with empathy for developers, including onboarding, authentication, documentation, observability, service discoverability, and lifecycle needs. Prior experience with Internal Developer Portals such as Backstage is a plus.
- Identity, Security, and Access Control: Experience with authentication, authorization, role-based access, policy-based access, API security, OpenAPI, or platform security workflows is highly desirable.
- Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.
- Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.
- Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.
- Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
- Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.
- Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.
- Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.
- Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
- Educational Background: Solid technical foundation, preferably with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees such as M.S. or MBA are a plus.

You will work at the intersection of AI, platform services, developer experience, security, data, and enterprise SaaS.

You will be expected to define how agents, tools, APIs, workflows, evaluation frameworks, permissions, and governance models come together to create reliable, secure, and scalable AI capabilities. This is a platform product role with a strong AI focus. The ideal candidate has deep platform product management experience, strong curiosity about AI, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical product outcomes.

What You Will Do

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of Agentic AI platform capabilities, from strategy and discovery to roadmap, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
- Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.
- Drive KPIs that reflect real-world AI and platform impact, including adoption, task completion, answer quality, automation success, deflection, operational efficiency, satisfaction, and reliability.

Minimum Requirements

What we are looking for:

- Experience: 15+ years of product management experience, including owning and driving large-scale technology platforms, AI products, developer-facing products, or enterprise SaaS capabilities across multiple lifecycle stages.
- Agentic AI Product Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI, LLMs, agents, tools, workflows, automation, and orchestration can be applied to enterprise SaaS products. Ability to think beyond chatbot experiences and define how AI can help users complete meaningful tasks and business outcomes.
- AI Quality and Governance: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, test suites, trace analysis, human review, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong awareness of AI risks around accuracy, privacy, security, explainability, permissions, and compliance.
- Technical Depth: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, SaaS business models, microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architectures, API-first design, data integrations, and modern enterprise architecture. Ability to translate technical possibilities into product outcomes.
- Platform Product Management: Strong platform mindset with experience creating reusable capabilities, standards, interfaces, and services that support multiple product teams and business use cases.
- Developer Experience: Ability to build platform services with empathy for developers, including onboarding, authentication, documentation, observability, service discoverability, and lifecycle needs. Prior experience with Internal Developer Portals such as Backstage is a plus.
- Identity, Security, and Access Control: Experience with authentication, authorization, role-based access, policy-based access, API security, OpenAPI, or platform security workflows is highly desirable.
- Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.
- Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.
- Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.
- Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
- Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.
- Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.
- Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.
- Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
- Educational Background: Solid technical foundation, preferably with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees such as M.S. or MBA are a plus.

Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.

Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

- Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
- Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.

Benefits

G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more.

Individuals residing, or applying to work, in the United States: California or Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, please review the following additional information:

G-P will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance. events.source_text:
About Us

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About This Position

As a Principal Product Manager for Agentic AI Platform at G-P, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our Agentic AI strategy and driving the success of platform capabilities that enable AI-powered experiences across our products and operations. You will work at the intersection of AI, platform services, developer experience, security, data, and enterprise SaaS.

You will be expected to define how agents, tools, APIs, workflows, evaluation frameworks, permissions, and governance models come together to create reliable, secure, and scalable AI capabilities. This is a platform product role with a strong AI focus. The ideal candidate has deep platform product management experience, strong curiosity about AI, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical product outcomes.

What You Will Do

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of Agentic AI platform capabilities, from strategy and discovery to roadmap, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
- Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.
- Drive KPIs that reflect real-world AI and platform impact, including adoption, task completion, answer quality, automation success, deflection, operational efficiency, satisfaction, and reliability.

Minimum Requirements

What we are looking for:

- Experience: 15+ years of product management experience, including owning and driving large-scale technology platforms, AI products, developer-facing products, or enterprise SaaS capabilities across multiple lifecycle stages.
- Agentic AI Product Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI, LLMs, agents, tools, workflows, automation, and orchestration can be applied to enterprise SaaS products. Ability to think beyond chatbot experiences and define how AI can help users complete meaningful tasks and business outcomes.
- AI Quality and Governance: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, test suites, trace analysis, human review, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong awareness of AI risks around accuracy, privacy, security, explainability, permissions, and compliance.
- Technical Depth: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, SaaS business models, microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architectures, API-first design, data integrations, and modern enterprise architecture. Ability to translate technical possibilities into product outcomes.
- Platform Product Management: Strong platform mindset with experience creating reusable capabilities, standards, interfaces, and services that support multiple product teams and business use cases.
- Developer Experience: Ability to build platform services with empathy for developers, including onboarding, authentication, documentation, observability, service discoverability, and lifecycle needs. Prior experience with Internal Developer Portals such as Backstage is a plus.
- Identity, Security, and Access Control: Experience with authentication, authorization, role-based access, policy-based access, API security, OpenAPI, or platform security workflows is highly desirable.
- Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.
- Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.
- Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.
- Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
- Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.
- Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.
- Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.
- Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
- Educational Background: Solid technical foundation, preferably with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees such as M.S. or MBA are a plus.

Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.

Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

- Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
- Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.

Benefits

G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more.

Individuals residing, or applying to work, in the United States: California or Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, please review the following additional information:

G-P will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance. Los Angeles applicants can review additional information regarding the Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act here: Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and Philadelphia applicants can review information pertaining to Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance here: Fair Chance Poster. Any consideration of a candidate’s background check with arrest or conviction records will include an individualized assessment based on the factors required by applicable law, including the candidate’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job.

G-P. Global Made Possible.

G-P is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to building and maintaining a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity. We prohibit discrimination and harassment against employees or applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

G-P also is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these positions. If you need an accommodation due to a disability during the interview process, please contact us at careers@g-p.com.

About This Position

You will work at the intersection of AI, platform services, developer experience, security, data, and enterprise SaaS.

You will be expected to define how agents, tools, APIs, workflows, evaluation frameworks, permissions, and governance models come together to create reliable, secure, and scalable AI capabilities. This is a platform product role with a strong AI focus. The ideal candidate has deep platform product management experience, strong curiosity about AI, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical product outcomes.

What You Will Do

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of Agentic AI platform capabilities, from strategy and discovery to roadmap, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
- Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.
- Drive KPIs that reflect real-world AI and platform impact, including adoption, task completion, answer quality, automation success, deflection, operational efficiency, satisfaction, and reliability.

Minimum Requirements

- Experience: 15+ years of product management experience, including owning and driving large-scale technology platforms, AI products, developer-facing products, or enterprise SaaS capabilities across multiple lifecycle stages.
- Agentic AI Product Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI, LLMs, agents, tools, workflows, automation, and orchestration can be applied to enterprise SaaS products. Ability to think beyond chatbot experiences and define how AI can help users complete meaningful tasks and business outcomes.
- AI Quality and Governance: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, test suites, trace analysis, human review, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong awareness of AI risks around accuracy, privacy, security, explainability, permissions, and compliance.
- Technical Depth: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, SaaS business models, microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architectures, API-first design, data integrations, and modern enterprise architecture. Ability to translate technical possibilities into product outcomes.
- Platform Product Management: Strong platform mindset with experience creating reusable capabilities, standards, interfaces, and services that support multiple product teams and business use cases.
- Developer Experience: Ability to build platform services with empathy for developers, including onboarding, authentication, documentation, observability, service discoverability, and lifecycle needs. Prior experience with Internal Developer Portals such as Backstage is a plus.
- Identity, Security, and Access Control: Experience with authentication, authorization, role-based access, policy-based access, API security, OpenAPI, or platform security workflows is highly desirable.
- Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.
- Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.
- Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.
- Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
- Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.
- Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.
- Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.
- Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
- Educational Background: Solid technical foundation, preferably with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees such as M.S. or MBA are a plus.

- Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About This Position

As a Principal Product Manager for Agentic AI Platform at G-P, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our Agentic AI strategy and driving the success of platform capabilities that enable AI-powered experiences across our products and operations. You will work at the intersection of AI, platform services, developer experience, security, data, and enterprise SaaS.

You will be expected to define how agents, tools, APIs, workflows, evaluation frameworks, permissions, and governance models come together to create reliable, secure, and scalable AI capabilities. This is a platform product role with a strong AI focus. The ideal candidate has deep platform product management experience, strong curiosity about AI, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical product outcomes.

What You Will Do

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of Agentic AI platform capabilities, from strategy and discovery to roadmap, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
- Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.
- Drive KPIs that reflect real-world AI and platform impact, including adoption, task completion, answer quality, automation success, deflection, operational efficiency, satisfaction, and reliability.

Minimum Requirements

What we are looking for:

- Experience: 15+ years of product management experience, including owning and driving large-scale technology platforms, AI products, developer-facing products, or enterprise SaaS capabilities across multiple lifecycle stages.
- Agentic AI Product Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI, LLMs, agents, tools, workflows, automation, and orchestration can be applied to enterprise SaaS products. Ability to think beyond chatbot experiences and define how AI can help users complete meaningful tasks and business outcomes.
- AI Quality and Governance: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, test suites, trace analysis, human review, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong awareness of AI risks around accuracy, privacy, security, explainability, permissions, and compliance.
- Technical Depth: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, SaaS business models, microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architectures, API-first design, data integrations, and modern enterprise architecture. Ability to translate technical possibilities into product outcomes.
- Platform Product Management: Strong platform mindset with experience creating reusable capabilities, standards, interfaces, and services that support multiple product teams and business use cases.
- Developer Experience: Ability to build platform services with empathy for developers, including onboarding, authentication, documentation, observability, service discoverability, and lifecycle needs. Prior experience with Internal Developer Portals such as Backstage is a plus.
- Identity, Security, and Access Control: Experience with authentication, authorization, role-based access, policy-based access, API security, OpenAPI, or platform security workflows is highly desirable.
- Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.
- Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.
- Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.
- Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
- Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.
- Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.
- Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.
- Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
- Educational Background: Solid technical foundation, preferably with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees such as M.S. or MBA are a plus.

Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.

Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

- Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
- Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.

Benefits

G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more.

Individuals residing, or applying to work, in the United States: California or Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, please review the following additional information:

G-P will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance. Los Angeles applicants can review additional information regarding the Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act here: Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and Philadelphia applicants can review information pertaining to Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance here: Fair Chance Poster. Any consideration of a candidate’s background check with arrest or conviction records will include an individualized assessment based on the factors required by applicable law, including the candidate’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job.

G-P. Global Made Possible.

G-P is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to building and maintaining a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity. We prohibit discrimination and harassment against employees or applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

G-P also is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these positions. If you need an accommodation due to a disability during the interview process, please contact us at careers@g-p.com.

About This Position

You will work at the intersection of AI, platform services, developer experience, security, data, and enterprise SaaS.

You will be expected to define how agents, tools, APIs, workflows, evaluation frameworks, permissions, and governance models come together to create reliable, secure, and scalable AI capabilities. This is a platform product role with a strong AI focus. The ideal candidate has deep platform product management experience, strong curiosity about AI, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical product outcomes.

What You Will Do

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of Agentic AI platform capabilities, from strategy and discovery to roadmap, execution, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
- Define and drive key AI platform capabilities, including agents, tools, action interfaces, API integrations, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Partner with engineering, data, security, and product teams to build scalable AI-powered capabilities using cloud-native, SaaS, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
- Own the product strategy for how agents answer questions, assist users, take actions, access data, use tools, and safely interact with business systems.
- Work with business product teams to identify and prioritize high-value agentic use cases across customer experience, professional experience, reporting, onboarding, compliance, support, and internal operations.
- Drive a platform approach for AI by creating reusable patterns, shared capabilities, clear standards, and developer-friendly interfaces that can be adopted across multiple teams and products.
- Define AI quality and evaluation requirements, including golden datasets, test cases, pass/fail criteria, trace reviews, regression testing, and production monitoring.
- Collaborate with identity, security, and platform teams to ensure agentic actions follow proper authentication, authorization, permissions, auditability, privacy, and compliance controls.
- Drive a developer-centric approach for Agentic AI platform services by improving discoverability, documentation, onboarding, usability, and adoption for internal product and engineering teams.
- Use AI-powered tools in your own product workflow to improve discovery, analysis, documentation, prioritization, decision-making, and execution.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, manage trade-offs, and ensure successful adoption of AI platform capabilities.
- Drive KPIs that reflect real-world AI and platform impact, including adoption, task completion, answer quality, automation success, deflection, operational efficiency, satisfaction, and reliability.

Minimum Requirements

What we are looking for:

- Experience: 15+ years of product management experience, including owning and driving large-scale technology platforms, AI products, developer-facing products, or enterprise SaaS capabilities across multiple lifecycle stages.
- Agentic AI Product Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI, LLMs, agents, tools, workflows, automation, and orchestration can be applied to enterprise SaaS products. Ability to think beyond chatbot experiences and define how AI can help users complete meaningful tasks and business outcomes.
- AI Quality and Governance: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods such as golden datasets, test suites, trace analysis, human review, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong awareness of AI risks around accuracy, privacy, security, explainability, permissions, and compliance.
- Technical Depth: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, SaaS business models, microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architectures, API-first design, data integrations, and modern enterprise architecture. Ability to translate technical possibilities into product outcomes.
- Platform Product Management: Strong platform mindset with experience creating reusable capabilities, standards, interfaces, and services that support multiple product teams and business use cases.
- Developer Experience: Ability to build platform services with empathy for developers, including onboarding, authentication, documentation, observability, service discoverability, and lifecycle needs. Prior experience with Internal Developer Portals such as Backstage is a plus.
- Identity, Security, and Access Control: Experience with authentication, authorization, role-based access, policy-based access, API security, OpenAPI, or platform security workflows is highly desirable.
- Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.
- Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.
- Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.
- Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
- Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.
- Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.
- Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.
- Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
- Educational Background: Solid technical foundation, preferably with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees such as M.S. or MBA are a plus.

About This Position
